question.question: How much does the selected development MAE of the K1 post-BN 100K recipe vary with the initial weights alone (torch seeds 45 and 46, added to measured seeds 42, 43 and 44)?
question.deficiency: K1 100K screens are single-seed. Three initial states (42, 43, 44) span 1.63 meV, while recent screen effects are below 1 meV (decay timescale -0.19 meV); n=3 cannot estimate the noise floor that the 3 meV gate is read against.
alternatives: Data order or dropout noise dominates init noise
Five initial states still underestimate full seed variance
Kaggle hardware nondeterminism adds run-to-run drift
question.positive_decision: Measurement only, no gate: report per-seed selected MAE (n=5), range, sample SD with chi-square 95% CI, paired-delta SD and the ratio of the 3 meV gate to it, for a human reading of past and future screens.
question.negative_decision: Measurement only, no gate: if either arm fails, report the available seeds as measured and run no successor, retry outside the infrastructure rule, extra seed or scale-up.

profile.cheapest_falsifier: One T4x2 session, two init-only replicates of the frozen K1 post-BN recipe, one arm per device.
